tools.description: Search text files under /testbed for a Python regular expression and return line-numbered context snippets. Useful for locating event names, reader/transform functions, and all call sites before changing code. Pure static search: does not modify files, run commands, or inspect history.
tools.label: Static Code Search
tools.name: code_search

context_lines.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match; defaults to 3.

file_pattern.description: Python regular expression matched against each file basename; defaults to .*[.]py$.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to include in the output; defaults to 50.

pattern.description: Python regular expression to search for in file contents.

search_path.description: Directory under /testbed to search recursively; relative values resolve under /testbed; defaults to /testbed.
